title: 7. Make the app-shell stack current: email block and the 120 minute build timeout (before S6)
description:
Not a pin change. The Amplify app has no _BUILD_TIMEOUT, so Amplify stops a job at 30 minutes; S6 creates 23 indexes (about 54 minutes by Machines on Machines job 107, which Amplify stopped at 30 while CloudFormation kept running). The app-shell stack amplify-app-shell-distinctive-cms was last updated 2026-10-22 and infra/site.json does not validate against current Papyrus: papyrus-infra synth fails with 'email is required for cloud sites' (required since 5.34.0).
Do: (1) add the email block to infra/site.json: mode existing, the newsletter sending domain, configurationSet papyrus-distinctive, and the newsletter event topic (take the real values from the newsletter plugin's resources; they were not checked); leave cms.buildTimeoutMinutes at its default 120. (2) With the 5.112.1 papyrus-infra (infra/package.json may move to 5.112.1 alone for this), run papyrus-infra synth, create a CloudFormation change set against the live stack, and have a person read it: expect Modify actions only; no replacement of the Amplify app or branch is acceptable (the branch holds the backend). (3) Apply it the way Ryan decides in task 1 (a reviewed person-run deploy, or the app-shell deploy workflow; Machines on Machines' ci/app-shell-deploy PR is open and unmerged). Nothing by hand in the console.
Acceptance:
Scenario: The timeout is set and nothing else moved
  Given the reviewed change set has no replacement
  When it is applied
  Then aws amplify get-app shows _BUILD_TIMEOUT 120 and the app id, branch and domain are unchanged
